title: stablerun
description: Calibrated agent-based model of a payment-stablecoin run and its spillovers to the US Treasury-bill market: heterogeneous holders, a secondary market with capital-constrained arbitrage, an issuer with a redemption queue and a liquidation waterfall, and a bill market with permanent and temporary price impact. Calibrated to the USDC (March 2023) and USDT (May 2022) episodes. Companion software to the working paper "When Stablecoins Run: Fire-Sale Spillovers to the Treasury Bill Market. An Agent-Based Stress Test" (https://github.com/thanatchon36/stablerun/raw/main/paper.pdf).
